sources.snippet: FraudGuard is an AI-powered fraud detection system designed to identify suspicious financial transactions using advanced machine learning techniques. Built for precision and scalability, the system evaluates transactional patterns and flags potential fraud in real time — with a focus on performance, security, and interpretability.
